propositions: BindingStore module is overly monolithic at 799 lines, owning byte persistence, lifecycle policy, recovery, rotation, and comment identity with no cohesive owner for safety rules
Production code mutates inner entries returned by shallow all_bindings() compatibility query, creating mutation-through-query anti-pattern that must be eliminated
Decompose BindingStore into a public facade with three internal owners: byte-preserving repository/unit-of-work, lifecycle policy, and incomplete-operation recovery

Implement journal-free retirement completion rule: durable tombstone is authoritative intent, and live forward/reverse pair removed only when all identities agree; only explicit unretire revokes intent
Live recovery must run after configuration snapshot and exclusive lock validation but before remote issue fetch to prevent upgraded pass from interleaving new liveness evidence with completion
Preserve all existing serialization behavior including unknown fields, indent=2, sorted keys, trailing newline, and unchanged-pass byte/HEAD idempotency across decomposition
